usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing HA group's node membership, failback behavior, or restricted-placement policy — note the Proxmox API marks this endpoint deprecated in favor of HA rules. The call requires `Sys.Console` on `/` and returns null synchronously (no UPID); changes take effect immediately in the CRM. Pass the `digest` field (obtained from the GET endpoint) to guard against concurrent edits clobbering each other.

examples.summary: Update 'prod-ha' group to pin resources to two nodes with priority, disable failback, and restrict placement to those nodes only

params.comment: Production HA group — no failback, restricted to primary nodes

tips: Node priority is optional per node; omit it to treat all nodes as equal weight (e.g. 'pve-node1,pve-node2').
Setting 'restricted: true' without a complete 'nodes' list can leave HA resources with nowhere valid to run — verify all target nodes are online before saving.
Use the 'delete' param (comma-separated config keys like 'comment,nofailback') to unset fields rather than setting them to empty strings.
This endpoint is deprecated; prefer HA rules (ha/rules) for new configurations, but this endpoint remains the only way to edit pre-existing groups in-place.
